title: Private Equity Buyouts and Employee Health
eligible_reason: All regressions are matched-pair event studies of the form xtreg y pre_t5 pre_t4 pre_t3 pre_t2 t0 t1 t2 t3 t4 (relative-year main effects for BOTH treated and matched control employees, who inherit the treated employee's event year) + the same dummies interacted with treated + i.year, fe vce(cluster rbe_id). The relative-time main effects are additional nonredundant additive fixed effects beyond individual and calendar-year FE, which the protocol excludes; most tables further add triple interactions with health, wage or age characteristics (pre_t*_x_rf, t*_x_tr_rf). No static TWFE on a plain post x treated indicator is estimated (post_x_treated is generated at line 108 but never used in a regression). The data are non-exportable CBS microdata and are not in the package.
design_notes: Employee-year panel (rin_unique x year, 2006-2016) of employees of Dutch firms acquired by PE (treated, event_year = buyout year, multiple years) and nearest-neighbour matched control employees (matched on industry, pre-event medication use, sex, year; euclidean distance; control_PE_employees_v06.do). Relative time t = year - event_year, sample keep if t > -3 & t < 5 (analysis_final_v06.do l.350). Outcomes: antidepressants, cardiovascular, digestive, medication_total, hexpenditures (Figure 1 D-F / Table OA5, l.369), employment states (l.558), income and transfers (l.796, 854), medication groups (l.966ff). Cluster rbe_id (employer). Table 9 c5-c7 use hedonic wage regressions and other outcomes. Figures 1-3 report the event-study coefficients.
never_treated_note: Matched control employees are never treated (treated = 0).
reports_modern_estimator_note: Full-text flags mention Callaway, Sun-Abraham and de Chaisemartin; no such estimator appears in the do-files, so these are likely cited in discussion.

specs.exclusion_reason: relative-time main effects (pre_t5..t4) for all units are nonredundant additive FE in addition to individual and year FE; matched-pair design with pseudo event dates for controls
specs.treatment_var: pre_t5_x_treated pre_t4_x_treated pre_t3_x_treated pre_t2_x_treated t0_x_treated t1_x_treated t2_x_treated t3_x_treated t4_x_treated (t = -1 omitted)
specs.treatment_definition: treated = employee of a PE-acquired firm at t-1; event_year = buyout year; relative-year dummies interacted with treated
specs.fe: rin_unique (xtreg fe) + i.year + relative-time dummies pre_t5..t4
specs.controls: none beyond the event-time main effects
specs.sample_condition: t in [-2, 4]; years 2006-2016; sum_dead not in {1,2}
specs.reported_location: Figure 1 D-F; coefficients in Table OA5 (results/Fig1_DEF_.txt)
specs.notes: near-miss: dropping the event-time main effects would give an unstacked TWFE event study on the matched sample.

specs.exclusion_reason: triple interactions of event-time x treated with employee characteristics (health, wage, tenure, age, sex)
specs.treatment_var: t*_x_treated plus t*_x_rf and t*_x_tr_rf interactions
specs.controls: characteristic main effect and its event-time interactions

specs.exclusion_reason: same event-time main effects structure as F1_DEF
specs.outcome: active_stayer active_changer not_employed retired disability ui (558); blsv_win daily_wage_win svdg_adj (796); insurance_adj disability_adj retired_adj ui_adj (854)

data_access_detail: Statistics Netherlands (CBS) remote-access microdata; non-exportable. README: 'All original, processed, and analytical datasets ... are archived within the CBS infrastructure and are only accessible from within the secure CBS environment.'
data_files_note: Package contains do-files, logs and result tables (results/*.txt, *.log) only.
software_notes: Stata MP 16.1, estout; about 100 hours of runtime on CBS servers.
priority_note: Not eligible as reported (event-time main effects, triple interactions) and data inaccessible outside CBS.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Specification read from analysis_final_v06.do lines 91-108 (dummy construction) and 328-331 (baseline_effects / interaction_effects locals). Even if the event-time main effects were deemed acceptable, replication would require CBS access.
